# Required status checks for pull requests into main (issue #490,
# F-CI-004/F-CI-014).
#
# One context per line, spelled exactly as the check run reports it: a job's
# `name:` (matrix expressions substituted), else its job id, plus the
# ` (v1, v2)` matrix suffix. Blank lines and `#` lines are ignored.
#
# This file is the reviewed record of what branch protection on main must
# require; it does not change protection by itself. A maintainer applies it
# with the command in CONTRIBUTING.md ("Required checks and review").
# tools/ci/check-required-checks.sh (verify-helpers job, blocking) fails when
# a context here names no job that reports on a pull request into main — a
# renamed job, a path-filtered workflow, a tag- or schedule-only job — and
# `--live montimage-projects/mmt-dpi` compares this list with the live one.
#
# Renaming a job listed here: update this file in the same PR, and swap the
# context in branch protection when that PR merges (the old name is never
# reported again, so every later PR would wait on it).

build

# swaps the context at its merge, #490).
